source: CRON 20261120_0355: 9M 2026 column completed from the bank's unaudited nine month results to 30 September 2026 as reported by Business Daily (nation.africa) and Capital FM Business: total operating income KES 18.64bn, operating expenses KES 11.39bn, profit before tax KES 7.26bn, profit after tax KES 6.07bn, EPS KES 3.65 (up from 2.49). Revenue carries total operating income, the same basis as the stored H1 2026 column. Operating Expenses is stored negative to match the other periods in this file. Operating Profit (EBIT) carries profit before tax, the convention already stored for H1 2026 and the annual columns of this bank. Income Tax is derived as profit before tax less the stored profit after tax (1,190,187,000) and the identity ties exactly. | Family Bank Limited unaudited half year results for the six months ended 30 June 2026: total operating income KES 12.09bn, net interest income KES 9,788.76m, total interest income KES 14.3bn, loan loss provisions KES 998.25m, total operating expenses KES 7.42bn, profit before tax KES 4.67bn, profit after tax KES 3,703.77m, basic and diluted EPS KES 2.23. Taken from the bank listed half year results and the S&P Capital IQ earnings record of the same statement.
source_note: KShs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. The 9M 2026 column is the Group income statement for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 in the bank's unaudited disclosures filed on the NSE: total interest income 22,027,172, total interest expense 7,002,998, net interest income 15,024,174, non-interest income 3,620,028, total operating income 18,644,202, loan loss provision 1,725,372, operating expenses 11,385,346, profit before tax 7,258,856, profit after tax 6,068,669 and earnings per share 3.65, in Shs thousands.

_cron_repair_20261006.h1_2026_rebuild: H1 2026 column rebuilt: the previous column copied profit after tax into Operating Profit (EBIT) and Profit Before Tax and left Income Tax blank.
_cron_repair_20261006.previous_source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed) | FY2025: Family Bank Limited audited financial statements and other disclosures for the period ended 31 December 2025, GROUP column, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP unqualified, https://familybank.co.ke/family-bank/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/FAMILY_BANK_LIMITED_Audited_Financial_Statement_and_Other_Disclosures_the_Period_31st_December_2025.pdf . Filing prints Shs 000, stored here in KES. Revenue is the statement's Total Operating Income (the bank's top line); Income Tax follows the file's existing convention (magnitude of current plus deferred tax). Operating Profit (EBIT) added as a derived row: total operating income less total operating expenses reproduces the printed profit before tax exactly for FY2023 (13,384,364 less 10,188,551 equals 3,195,813 thousand), FY2024 (3,916,337) and FY2025 (6,330,352, printed 6,330,351), so the bank has no items between operating profit and profit before tax. Family Bank prints no cost of sales and no gross profit line.
